inj.note: Fagnano -- who approached Sunday's contest as the Ravens' emergency No. 3 QB -- took some hard hits after replacing the team's top two QBs (Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley). With Jackson slated to land on IR with a thumb injury and Huntley dealing with a toe issue, Fagnano may be pressed into a Week 9 start versus Jacksonville, provided he's not too banged up to handle the assignment.
